<style data-page-node-id="oUTl4et7gn8nBYOGteBzUd" data-pnid-children="okMs8l39ZlFY2dfPQA8qDu">
:root{
  --bg:#f4f6f9; --card:#fff; --line:#e6e9ef; --ink:#1c2536; --muted:#6b7688;
  --brand:#1f6feb; --brand-soft:#eaf2ff; --hot:#d92d20; --hot-soft:#fdecea;
  --warm:#b54708; --warm-soft:#fdf3e3;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);
  font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;
  font-size:14px;line-height:1.6}
.wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:22px 18px 60px}
header h1{font-size:21px;margin:0 0 6px;letter-spacing:.2px}
.sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px}
.kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:12px;margin:18px 0}
.kpi{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:14px 16px}
.kpi b{display:block;font-size:24px;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:-.5px}
.kpi span{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
.panel{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;margin-bottom:16px}
.filters{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:flex-end}
.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px}
.field label{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted)}
input[type=text],input[type=date],select{
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:7px 10px;font-size:13px;
  background:#fff;color:var(--ink);outline:none;min-width:130px;font-family:inherit}
input:focus,select:focus{border-color:var(--brand);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--brand-soft)}
button{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 14px;
  font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink);font-family:inherit}
button:hover{border-color:#c9d2e0}
button.primary{background:var(--brand);border-color:var(--brand);color:#fff}
button.primary:hover{background:#1a5fd0}
.hos{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;margin-bottom:12px;overflow:hidden}
.hos-head{padding:12px 16px;background:#fbfcfe;border-bottom:1px solid #eef1f6;
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hos-head h2{font-size:14.5px;margin:0;font-weight:600}
.hos-head .n{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.item{padding:11px 16px;border-top:1px solid #f3f5f8;display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:space-between}
.item:hover{background:#fafcff}
.item .t{flex:1;min-width:0}
.item a{color:var(--brand);text-decoration:none;font-size:14px;word-break:break-word}
.item a:hover{text-decoration:underline;color:#1a5fd0}
.ext{display:inline-block;margin-left:4px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);vertical-align:1px;opacity:.65}
.meta{margin-top:5px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.tag{display:inline-block;border-radius:5px;padding:1px 7px;background:#eef2f7;color:#57606a;font-size:11px}
.tag.hot{background:var(--hot-soft);color:var(--hot);font-weight:600}
.tag.warm{background:var(--warm-soft);color:var(--warm)}
.tag.src{background:var(--brand-soft);color:#0b57d0}
.empty{padding:16px;color:#8b95a5;font-size:13px}
.pager{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:10px;margin-top:6px;align-items:center}
footer{text-align:center;color:#98a2b3;font-size:12px;margin-top:24px;line-height:1.9}
.loading{padding:26px 16px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.err{padding:20px 18px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.9}
.err b{color:var(--hot);display:block;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:14px}
.err code{background:#f4f6f9;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:5px;
  padding:1px 6px;font-size:12px;word-break:break-all}
.err ol{margin:10px 0 0;padding-left:20px}
.err .retry{margin-top:12px}
</style><!--pnid:HqNAOwFpoTDQKT86Z1UpO7-->

<script data-page-node-id="4WwWv8zu4Ue4fA29d32IVk" data-pnid-children="G6AnuqfaCmBFJOjieK8Cfp">
/* ==========================================================================
   index.html 是「程序」，news.json 是「数据」——两者解耦。
   页面逻辑不变时，只更新 news.json 即可，本文件无需重新发布。
   ========================================================================== */

var DATA_URL = null;  /* 数据已内联，见页面底部 __NEWS_DATA__ */
var F = {title:'新闻标题', hosp:'医院', pub:'发布时间', day:'采集日期',
         ch:'所属栏目', via:'来源通道', win:'是否区间内', url:'新闻链接'};
var PAGE_SIZE = 50;
var state = {page:1, rows:[], filtered:[]};

function el(id){return document.getElementById(id);}
function safeUrl(u){
  var v = String(u==null?'':u).trim();
  if(!v) return '';
  return /^https?:\/\//i.test(v) ? encodeURI(v) : '';
}
function pickLink(v){
  if(v==null) return '';
  if(typeof v==='string') return v;
  if(Array.isArray(v)){ for(var i=0;i<v.length;i++){var g=pickLink(v[i]); if(g) return g;} return ''; }
  if(typeof v==='object') return v.link||v.url||v.href||v.text||'';
  return '';
}

/* ---------------- 数据装载：fetch 失败时给出可操作提示 ---------------- */

function showLoadError(detail){
  var isFile = (location.protocol === 'file:');
  var box = el('list');
  box.textContent = '';
  var d = document.createElement('div');
  d.className = 'panel err';
  var h = document.createElement('b');
  h.textContent = isFile
    ? '无法加载数据：页面正以本地文件方式打开'
    : '无法加载数据：未能取到 news.json';
  d.appendChild(h);

  if(isFile){
    d.appendChild(document.createTextNode(
      '浏览器会拦截 file:// 下的 fetch 请求（同源策略）。请改用 HTTP 方式访问本页。'));
    var ol = document.createElement('ol');
    var li1 = document.createElement('li');
    li1.textContent = '在 index.html 所在目录执行：';
    var c1 = document.createElement('code');
    c1.textContent = 'python3 -m http.server 3000';
    li1.appendChild(c1);
    ol.appendChild(li1);
    var li2 = document.createElement('li');
    li2.textContent = '然后浏览器打开：';
    var c2 = document.createElement('code');
    c2.textContent = 'http://localhost:3000/index.html';
    li2.appendChild(c2);
    ol.appendChild(li2);
    d.appendChild(ol);
  }else{
    d.appendChild(document.createTextNode(
      '请确认 news.json 与 index.html 在同一目录下，且可被公开访问。'));
    var ol2 = document.createElement('ol');
    var l1 = document.createElement('li');
    l1.textContent = '预期地址：';
    var cc = document.createElement('code');
    cc.textContent = location.href.replace(/[^\/]*$/, '') + 'news.json';
    l1.appendChild(cc);
    ol2.appendChild(l1);
    var l2 = document.createElement('li');
    l2.textContent = '若返回 404 / 403，说明数据文件未上传或权限不足，需重新上传。';
    ol2.appendChild(l2);
    d.appendChild(ol2);
  }

  if(detail){
    var p = document.createElement('div');
    p.className = 'sub';
    p.style.marginTop = '10px';
    p.textContent = '技术细节：' + detail;
    d.appendChild(p);
  }

  var btn = document.createElement('button');
  btn.className = 'retry';
  btn.textContent = '重新加载';
  btn.addEventListener('click', function(){ load(); });
  d.appendChild(btn);

  box.appendChild(d);
  el('pager').style.display = 'none';
  el('subtitle').textContent = '数据加载失败';
}

function load(){
  /* 数据内联版：不走网络请求，直接读取页内 __NEWS_DATA__ */
  var box = el('list');
  box.textContent = '';
  try {
    var node = document.getElementById('__NEWS_DATA__');
    if(!node) throw new Error('页面缺少内联数据块 __NEWS_DATA__');
    var pack = JSON.parse(node.textContent);
    var rows = Array.isArray(pack) ? pack : (pack && pack.items) || [];
    boot(rows, (pack && pack.generated_at) || '');
  } catch(e) {
    showLoadError(e && e.message ? e.message : String(e));
  }
}

function boot(rows, generatedAt){
  DATA = rows;   /* 全局缓存，供 apply()/initKpis() 复用 */
  el('subtitle').textContent =
    '数据源：医院官网直采 · 每篇新闻一行记录 · 数据更新于 ' + (generatedAt || '未知');
  initKpis();
  state.filtered = DATA.slice();
  state.page = 1;
  render();
}

/* ---------------- 数据已就绪，无需再做 HTML 转义 ---------------- */

function apply(){
  var kw = el('f-kw').value.trim().toLowerCase();
  var hos = el('f-hos').value;
  var from = el('f-from').value;
  var to = el('f-to').value;
  state.filtered = DATA.filter(function(r){
    if(kw){
      var t = String(r[F.title]||'').toLowerCase();
      var c = String(r[F.ch]||'').toLowerCase();
      if(t.indexOf(kw)<0 && c.indexOf(kw)<0) return false;
    }
    if(hos && r[F.hosp]!==hos) return false;
    var d = String(r[F.pub]||'').slice(0,10);
    if(from && (!d || d < from)) return false;
    if(to && (!d || d > to)) return false;
    return true;
  });
  state.page = 1;
  render();
}

function render(){
  var rows = state.filtered;
  var box = el('list');
  box.textContent = '';
  if(!rows.length){
    var em = document.createElement('div');
    em.className = 'panel empty';
    em.textContent = '当前查询条件下没有匹配的新闻记录。';
    box.appendChild(em);
    el('pager').style.display='none';
    return;
  }
  var start = (state.page-1)*PAGE_SIZE;
  var pageRows = rows.slice(start, start+PAGE_SIZE);

  var groups = {}, order = [];
  pageRows.forEach(function(r){
    var h = r[F.hosp] || '未标注医院';
    if(!groups[h]){groups[h]=[]; order.push(h);}
    groups[h].push(r);
  });

  order.forEach(function(h){
    var items = groups[h];
    var card = document.createElement('div'); card.className='hos';
    var head = document.createElement('div'); head.className='hos-head';
    var h2 = document.createElement('h2'); h2.textContent = h;
    var cnt = document.createElement('div'); cnt.className='n'; cnt.textContent = items.length+' 条';
    head.appendChild(h2); head.appendChild(cnt); card.appendChild(head);

    items.forEach(function(r){
      var title = r[F.title] || '(无标题)';
      var link = pickLink(r[F.url]);
      var date = String(r[F.pub]||'').slice(0,10);
      var win = r[F.win];

      var item = document.createElement('div'); item.className='item';
      var tw = document.createElement('div'); tw.className='t';
      var su = safeUrl(link);
      if(su){
        var a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = su; a.target='_blank'; a.rel='noopener noreferrer';
        a.title = '在新标签页打开原文：'+su;
        a.textContent = title;
        var ext = document.createElement('span'); ext.className='ext'; ext.textContent='\u2197';
        a.appendChild(ext); tw.appendChild(a);
      }else{
        var sp = document.createElement('span'); sp.textContent = title; tw.appendChild(sp);
      }
      var meta = document.createElement('div'); meta.className='meta';
      var dtag = document.createElement('span');
      dtag.className = 'tag' + (date ? (win ? ' hot' : ' warm') : '');
      dtag.textContent = date ? (date + (win ? '' : '（最近）')) : '日期未标注';
      meta.appendChild(dtag);
      if(r[F.ch]){var ct=document.createElement('span'); ct.className='tag'; ct.textContent=r[F.ch]; meta.appendChild(ct);}
      var via = r[F.via]==='官网直采' ? '官网直采' : (r[F.via]||'官网域内检索');
      var vt = document.createElement('span'); vt.className='tag src'; vt.textContent=via; meta.appendChild(vt);
      if(r[F.day]){var d2=document.createElement('span'); d2.textContent='入库 '+String(r[F.day]).slice(0,10); meta.appendChild(d2);}
      if(su){
        var ga=document.createElement('a'); ga.href=su; ga.target='_blank';
        ga.rel='noopener noreferrer'; ga.textContent='查看原文 ↗'; meta.appendChild(ga);
      }
      tw.appendChild(meta); item.appendChild(tw); card.appendChild(item);
    });
    box.appendChild(card);
  });

  var totalPages = Math.ceil(rows.length/PAGE_SIZE);
  el('pager').style.display = totalPages>1 ? 'flex' : 'none';
  el('page-info').textContent = '第 '+state.page+' / '+totalPages+' 页（共 '+rows.length+' 条）';
  el('btn-prev').disabled = state.page<=1;
  el('btn-next').disabled = state.page>=totalPages;
}

function initKpis(){
  el('k-total').textContent = DATA.length;
  var set = {}, latest='', win=0;
  DATA.forEach(function(r){
    if(r[F.hosp]) set[r[F.hosp]]=1;
    if(r[F.win]) win++;
    var d = String(r[F.pub]||'').slice(0,10);
    if(d>latest) latest=d;
  });
  el('k-hos').textContent = Object.keys(set).length;
  el('k-win').textContent = win;
  el('k-latest').textContent = latest || '–';

  var sel = el('f-hos');
  Object.keys(set).sort().forEach(function(h){
    var o=document.createElement('option'); o.value=h; o.textContent=h; sel.appendChild(o);
  });
}

el('btn-search').addEventListener('click', apply);
el('btn-reset').addEventListener('click', function(){
  el('f-kw').value=''; el('f-hos').value=''; el('f-from').value=''; el('f-to').value='';
  apply();
});
el('btn-prev').addEventListener('click', function(){ if(state.page>1){state.page--; render();} });
el('btn-next').addEventListener('click', function(){
  var tp = Math.ceil(state.filtered.length/PAGE_SIZE);
  if(state.page<tp){state.page++; render();}
});
el('f-kw').addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.key==='Enter') apply(); });
el('f-hos').addEventListener('change', apply);
el('f-from').addEventListener('change', apply);
el('f-to').addEventListener('change', apply);

load();
</script><!--pnid:i2CNeWgOAz76B9ibez7T4b-->
